TRAFFIC ADVISORY

DAY 15, TUESDAY 14TH OCTOBER, 2025

COMMISSIONING OF ACCESS ROADS IN SECTOR CENTRE BY DAKIBIYU DISTRICT

The FCT motoring public are hereby informed of the commissioning of the above project by the Hon. Minister of the FCT, his Excellency Chief (Barr) Ezenwo Nyesom Wike CON.

As such traffic towards the Dakibiyu road (Asuquo Okon Way) will be slightly affected during movement of dignitaries.

The Jerry Eze street by Code of Conduct Tribunal, Dakibiyu is venue of the event.

Access to locations like Yaliam Press Ltd., Police Service Commission and others will be under controlled access by traffic and security personnel.

Deployment commences at 800hrs.

- Head Traffic, DRTS
